captains_call.title: scope-call
captains_call.decide: Choose the release route while preserving the current workflow and its recorded alternatives through the final review and the complete approval record: Which route should proceed? A: retain the supported workflow until every dependency completes its staged verification and the full downstream contract remains available for review. B: defer the independent migration through its observation period while retaining the rollback route and every currently supported integration. C: wait for the final café / 東京 / 🚢 approval and preserve the complete late option.
